rules: Mount mod/megaton-art/out/patch-art.dat (or stage its files) as mod/megaton-art's is today: it holds the OLD art unchanged, byte for byte, plus the new pieces (scenery PIDs from 2300, wall PIDs from 2100) and art/tiles (tiles.lst = stock + custom lines).

ORDER on the map: (1) `removed` (stock objects, three placements of the old plan, one stock object and four blockers added), (2) `roofs`, (3) `placements` in file order with pipeline.place.Placer (wall stretches first remove the fence sheets and 'Wall s.t.' blockers listed in their `remove`), (4) `floors`, (5) the town seals pockets and places the cast.

ROOFS: set the roof id of every square from roofs[building].tiles (or call pipeline.tiles.TileSet.reroof(map, box, sheet)). A hole in a roof is a BLANK custom tile, never 'no tile': the roof must stay one flood-fill region or it will not hide as one.

FLOORS: a decal square is a COMPOSED tile (the decal over the ground tile it lands on); floors[].squares gives the tiles.lst index for every square. If the ground under a decal ever changes, call TileSet.paint_floor again: it composes a new tile (tile slots are append-only: 269 of 994 are free).

CLICK RULE (as in mod/megaton-art/placement.py): nothing tall stands between the camera and a door, a person or a container. town/check.py restates the town's clickable / seen / trim / keep_free / reachable tests; re-run it after any move.

Roofs are painted after every object: a piece shows above a roof only when it stands BEHIND the building. The back strips (row hy_lo - 3 of each building) are full; the three spares cut for lack of a strip are listed under `pieces`.

also_block (kit/also_block.json): 29 ground pieces block one to seven hexes more than their geometry, so that nobody can stand where the engine would paint him over something in front of him. The town's lanes were re-checked with those hexes blocked.

art_cache_size: the town with this pass needs about twice the object art; with the test rig's 8 MB the engine logs 'Heap Warning' (evictions) on every view, with 16 or 24 MB none. The phone page already sets 24; tools/f2test.py runs use gamedata's 8.
